zechariah.7.p1.b1.text: In the fourth year of King Darius, the word of the LORD came to Zechariah on the fourth day of the ninth month, the month of Chislev.

zechariah.7.p1.b2.text: Should I weep and fast in the fifth month, as I have done these many years?

zechariah.7.p1.b3.text: When you fasted and mourned in the fifth and seventh months for these seventy years, was it really for Me that you fasted?

zechariah.7.p1.b4.text: Administer true justice. Show loving devotion and compassion to one another. Do not oppress the widow or the fatherless, the foreigner or the poor.

zechariah.7.p1.b5.text: But they refused to pay attention and turned a stubborn shoulder; they stopped up their ears from hearing. They made their hearts like flint …

zechariah.7.p1.b6.text: … the land was left desolate behind them so that no one could come or go. Thus they turned the pleasant land into a desolation.
